title: Lighthouse Cohort: Activation, Feedback Marshaling & Beta-to-GA Acceptance Criteria
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Organize and execute the activation and feedback lifecycle for the initial Lighthouse cohort (10 pilot accounts). This ticket coordinates cross-functional pre-launch checks, the customer handshake for success criteria, telemetry/observability setup, a lightweight feedback marshaling process, and the acceptance gates for promoting the beta to GA. Goals: reduce onboarding time, capture high-fidelity product feedback, validate SLA/latency signals, and establish repeatable remediation playbooks for customer blockers.
acceptance_criteria: All 10 lighthouse accounts have signed the pilot agreement and completed the kickoff checklist
Onboarding checklist: API keys provisioned, test dataset uploaded, routing policy configured, and telemetry dashboards deployed per account
Feedback pipeline in place: single canonical tracker (Google Sheet + Slack #lighthouse-feedback channel) and triage process documented
Success metrics and thresholds confirmed with each account (activation funnel baseline, latency percentile targets, error budget policy)
At least 3 cross-customer prompts/evals run, and any model regressions are documented with remediation plans
Runbook for priority P0/P1 customer blockers created and shared with Support & SRE
Stakeholder sign-off obtained (PM, ENG lead, CS lead, Privacy/Security where applicable) to consider cohort for GA promotion
tasks: Draft and circulate the Lighthouse Customer Handshake template (PM) - include acceptance criteria, expected inputs, and success signals
CS to schedule and run kickoffs with each account and capture configuration notes in shared drive
Eng to deploy per-account observability dashboard (latency, tokens/second, error rate, KV-cache hit) and add to console-2025.03 release group
Research to run 3 focused evals using cohort prompts and upload results to Drive
DevRel to prepare sample integration snippets and a quickstart repo for each customer
Support/SRE to author the P0/P1 remediation runbook and escalation ladder
PM to collate feedback weekly and produce the feedback digest for the steering committee

risks: Telemetry delivery slippage: Eng dashboards delayed -> blindspots in early weeks
Customer engagement variability: some lighthouse accounts may deprioritize pilot tasks leading to incomplete feedback
Model regression discovered late: if research evals happen post-kickoff, remediation could require rollback or manual prompts workarounds
SLA mismatches: pilot expectations on latency not aligned with Dedicated capacity limits for small cohorts
mitigations: Prioritize a lightweight baseline dashboard with core metrics (p50/p95 latency, token throughput, error rate) to ship by 2025-02-10
CS to require a 30-minute technical pre-kickoff to resolve configuration blockers before formal kickoff
Freeze non-critical service changes during active pilot windows and notify eng rotations
Document temporary fallback guidance (e.g., pin model variant, enable KV-cache aggressive TTL) for customers experiencing latency spikes
success_metrics: Activation: 80% of cohort completes 'first successful inference' within 48 hours of kickoff
Quality: no more than 1.5% regression on primary prompt set across cohort during pilot
Reliability: p95 latency < 300ms for 90% of requests under pilot traffic profiles
Engagement: weekly feedback submissions from at least 60% of accounts during pilot
Commercial signal: at least 4 accounts indicate interest in upgrading to Dedicated or committing to 3-month contract post-pilot
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Week 0-2): Execute kickoffs and baseline telemetry; confirm handshakes and sign-offs. Phase 2 (Week 3-6): Active pilot window; run evals, gather structured feedback, and iterate on config. Weekly syncs with steering committee; escalate P0s within 4 hours. Phase 3 (Week 7): Collate metrics, run decision meeting against acceptance criteria, produce GA recommendation and release notes draft. If criteria met, schedule GA announcement and post-launch follow-ups.
notes_for_review: Please review the Handshake template and the proposed acceptance thresholds. Engineering: confirm that telemetry endpoints can be instrumented per-account without infra changes. CS: validate that the kickoff cadence is realistic for your calendar. Security: we may need a quick review for any customer data uploads — flag if KMS integration is required.
postmortem_plan: If pilot fails to meet acceptance criteria, run a 2-week focused remediation sprint, capture learnings in a short postmortem (owner: PM), and only re-enroll accounts after fixes and a dry-run. Postmortem will be stored at https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LH/Postmortems
